active_family: native joint AR conditional generator for IV + anchor factors with shared source, shared transition mixer, mixed coordinates, and typed readout heads
current_bottleneck: 660a train-tail generation audit shows a mixed failure. Distribution shift materially worsens validation, but 658a still does not learn a deployable training conditional law: train-tail remains 5/11 and fails level occupancy, median placement, per-cell conditionality, regime-cell coverage, and some anchor support. Local movements and broad correlation shape are learned on both splits.
last_result_summary: 660a evaluated 658a on an in-training train-tail pseudo-validation slice by setting test_start=4070/val_size=441, corresponding to original training windows 3569..4009. Train-tail improves over validation: cov90 0.829 vs 0.687, conditional MAE reduction 5.79% vs -0.45%, turb/calm width 1.162 vs 0.956, bad window-floor 3.9% vs 18.6%, mean reversion passes vs fails, path max-jump KS 0.154 vs 0.480. But train-tail still scores only 5/11, with level KS 11/25, median-bias 14/25, regime layer2 1/8, and full-suite failures in coverage, conditionality, time_series, cointegration, regime_coverage, and distributional_fidelity. Joint train-tail improves factor KS mean 0.092 vs 0.109 and IV-factor corr shape 0.932 vs 0.868, but IV-factor abs-corr ratio remains attenuated at 0.606 train vs 0.592 validation.
next_step_recommendation: Use train-tail as the next falsification gate. Try objective balance or explicit level-placement loss on the same native-joint AR architecture. If train-tail becomes strong while validation remains weak, move to OOD calibration/adaptation. If train-tail remains weak, stop validation tuning because the model has not learned the training law.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain the historical short-frame best learned IV laws at 8/11. On the 441-window broad frame, 612a is the highest IV-count native joint run at 6/11 but has a degenerate source-scale mechanism and poor anchor-factor joint audit. 658a is now the cleanest native joint AR baseline: IV 5/11 with coherent factor/joint audit, but still not IV-deployable. 656a remains only a diagnostic stress-deck overlay because it is composed post hoc rather than generated by one mechanism.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
